integrity: Exact six-state proof with symbolic rational factorization; independently implemented Fraction elimination on 96 rational cases; computational checks are corroboration and do not certify infinite families independently.
scientific_limitations: No assertion for larger graphs, nonuniform initial mutant locations, resident-dependent environment, other updating rules, or historical priority outside the inspected evidence.
scientific_scope: A three-vertex undirected path with one designated high-fecundity mutant site, residents of unit fitness, uniform single-mutant introduction, and precisely defined Bd/dB rules.
title: Opposite habitat-placement rankings under birth–death and death–birth fixation on a three-site path
